title: Snack Chef
shareTitle: Snack Chef — Make playful fruit snacks
description: Spread, peel, slice, and arrange fruit faces, toast gardens, and banana boats in a warm storybook kitchen.
learningGoals: Follow a short picture recipe from beginning to end
Practice controlled circular and directional finger movements
Arrange ingredients with spatial planning and simple symmetry
Build positive familiarity with food preparation
interactionModel: broad scrub, swipe, peel, and strand-proof drag gestures with tap-to-place alternatives
feedbackModel: food changes directly under the finger, gentle spoken modeling, warm tactile sound effects, and a plated storybook reveal
credits: Kaigani; original game art produced with GPT Image 2 and Krea 2; teacher dialogue produced with Qwen voice clone and transcript-checked with Whisper; Maya and platform UI by QLOBE Kids.
